purpose: A shared inbox for small harbour offices.

content.heading: One inbox for berth requests, invoices and notices
content.body: Every message is a case with an owner and a due date.

content.heading: Berth requests
content.body: Approve or decline from the message itself.

content.heading: Invoices
content.body: Attach the tariff line and send.

content.heading: Notices to mariners
content.body: Publish once, notify every affected vessel.

content.heading: Request access
content.body: Leave your office name and we contact you.
